method: The research container could not open the site itself (outbound fetches are refused), so the features come from web-search results of the site's own pages (listed in sources) and from how the product is publicly known to work; a feature not confirmed by a search result says so in its detail. Verse's side was read from this repository's source.

features.name: Encode text to Base64
features.verse_evidence: Text box encodes as you type

features.name: Decode Base64 (sister site base64decode.org)
features.verse_evidence: Base64 box decodes as you type

features.name: Destination character set
features.detail: dozens of character sets (UTF-8, ISO-8859, Windows code pages, ...)

features.name: Encode files
features.detail: upload a file (size cap around 100 MB+) and download the result
features.verse_evidence: "A file to Base64": any size, read in slices, never uploaded

features.name: Sister encoders (URL encode/decode)
features.detail: the same publisher runs urlencoder.org / urldecoder.org (not confirmed by search)
features.verse_evidence: no percent-encoding page (skills only use encodeURIComponent internally)

features.name: Guides and examples
features.verse_evidence: footer explains the RFC 4648 rules; no guide pages
